function: Distributed uplink channel estimation at the access points of a cell-free massive MIMO system, with a CNN trained by the proposed FedVR federated-learning algorithm (p. 3, p. 5).
system: Cell-free massive MIMO uplink: M=8 APs with Nr=16 antennas each (Nr=8 also), single-antenna user, NC=256 subcarriers; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (p. 3, p. 7).
method: Six-layer CNN trained by federated learning with FedVR (FedAvg plus local correction variables for variance reduction); supervised MSE loss from received pilots to angle-delay channels (p. 5-7).
data_channel: Simulated QuaDRiGa 3GPP_38.901 UMa LOS/NLOS and Indoor_Open_Office channels; 1600 training and 800 test samples, APs in a 30-50 m ring (p. 7, p. 8, p. 9).
test_conditions: Loss curves: 1600 training and 800 test samples at SNR 0 dB; NMSE figures sweep SNR, antennas, subcarriers, APs, scenario; no unseen-condition test stated (p. 8-9).
baselines: Non-learned: centralized and fully decentralized LMMSE; learned: FedAvg-trained CNN, the protocol of earlier FL channel estimators [29]-[31] (p. 8-9, Figs. 7-11).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR, training and testing loss versus communication rounds, achievable data rate with MRT beamforming (p. 8-10).
complexity: CNN: 18NrNC operations per filter, 4050NrNC in total; Cholesky LMMSE: 5/6(NRNC)^3+2(NRNC)^2+13/6 NRNC (p. 8).
q1_support: p. 8: "“3GPP_38.901_UMa_LOS” channel model in QUaDRiGa" (also p. 4 and p. 9: 3GPP_38.901 UMa NLOS and Indoor_Open_Office in QuaDRiGa), used for training and testing.
q2_support: p. 8: "1600 data samples are used, while 800 data samples are used for testing" (held-out part of the same data). Figs. 7-10 (p. 9) vary antennas, subcarriers, APs and scenario, but no passage says a trained model is tested on a condition unseen in training; missing.
q3_support: p. 8: "the conventional LMMSE-based schemes and the FedAvg scheme are used as the benchmarks"; NMSE comparison in Figs. 7-10 (p. 9). FedAvg is the protocol of the earlier FL estimators [29]-[31] (p. 2).
q4_support: p. 8: "the computational complexity is given by 4050Nr NC" (CNN), compared with the Cholesky-based LMMSE cost 5/6(NRNC)^3+2(NRNC)^2+13/6 NRNC.
q5_support: p. 7: "channel generation dataset" QuaDRiGa, a channel generator run with the authors' own parameters (M=8, Nr=16, NC=256); no link to released code or generated data anywhere in the paper; missing.
notes: Area 2: the learned element is a CNN channel estimator; FL aggregation is digital (APs upload model updates to the CPU, p. 5), so not area 7. System check passes: APs have Nr=8 or 16 antennas (p. 3). q3: the FedAvg benchmark uses the same CNN as FedVR (p. 7) and stands for earlier FL estimators [29]-[31] (p. 2, p. 5); the reviewer may confirm it is not read as a training variant. q5: the paper calls QuaDRiGa a channel generation dataset (p. 7) and footnote 3 (p. 5), but it is a generator, so marked 0; reviewer to confirm.
